assessments.task: Locate the capsule between the upper-arm bone and the two forearm bones.

axes.observation: Eight exact source-named meshes preserve native placement and all 8,332 oriented triangles. The shared bone context supports static location while attachment mechanics remain outside scope.
Matched anterior and deep oblique captures preserve the capsular region, rounded bony landmarks and annular relationship. The joint surfaces retain source irregularities.
The colored capsule stays visible at the elbow on three bones. Hiding capsule and humerus reveals the selected deeper ligament structures.
Eight meshes retain 8,332 triangles and the same download size. The 1,728-triangle capsule remains independently selectable.

assessments.task: Locate shoulder capsule at the humeral head and orient to the scapula and clavicle.

axes.observation: Ten exact source-named meshes preserve the static pose and oriented nonzero-area faces. Two decoded zero-area scapular faces are confined to a 1.14 mm patch remote from the recorded spine and labrum anchors.
Matched exterior and deep oblique captures retain the capsule beside the humeral head, the acromial outline and the glenoid rim. Narrow soft-tissue overlaps persist.
Bone silhouette and colored soft tissues orient the learner to the capsule, scapular blade and clavicle. Hiding capsule and humerus exposes the regional glenoid relationships.
Ten pieces use 36,700 triangles with a 12-byte increase. The scapula preserves the blade and acromial contour, and the 3,232-triangle capsule is individually selectable.

assessments.task: Use the elbow region to locate the retained right ulnar course relative to the olecranon and medial epicondyle.

axes.observation: Native placement, oriented faces and world bone positions are preserved. The displayed nerve course replays within 0.000015 mm and remains a static gross locator.
Both detail views reproduce identical pixels. The fine nerve remains distinct against the broader medial epicondyle and olecranon.
The landmark plate follows the ochre nerve against the two named bones from medial and posteromedial angles. Whole-arm scale requires the detail crop for the nerve.
Four separately selectable meshes use 9,136 triangles, of which 3,168 draw the thin source nerve. The download is 736 bytes smaller.
